title: MYSTIC BALLOON
author: TEAM a.r.g.; CHGame port
description: Mystic Balloon with a native 128x128 scrolling playfield. Find the key, ride fans with your balloons, inhale enemies, and collect every coin through 39 original levels.

buttons.action: Look; UP enters an unlocked door
Jump; press again in the air and hold to float; confirm menus
Inhale enemies and coins; back in menus
Pause or resume; hold 3 seconds for the game menu
